- tests/test_investigate.py 36/36

**Notes:** 🔑 ONE CLAUSE OVERSTATES WHAT EXISTS, precisely. The done_when says 'all read-only (TEST ASSERTS NO STORE WRITES)'. No such assertion exists under any name: no test compares a file set, an mtime or a store snapshot before and after a resolve. The PROPERTY still holds, by two other means — the resolvers are pure reads by construction (the docstring's first guardrail) and the opened session is forced into ask mode, which is what actually prevents a mutation at turn time and IS driven. So the verdict is confirmed on the property and the atom's evidence sentence is the part that is wrong. Worth recording because 'a test asserts X' is the strongest claim a done_when can make, and it is the one a later reader is least likely to re-check.
